title: Pocketwire Rewards Redemption Limits and Fulfilment Times
content:
Pocketwire Rewards redemptions are bounded per tier by the minimums, the increment, the daily cash limit, the gift card and donation fulfilment time and the cancellation window below.

| Tier | Minimum cash redemption (points) | Minimum gift card or charity redemption (points) | Redemption increment (points) | Most points redeemed to cash per calendar day | Fulfilment time (business days after the redemption date) | Cancellation window (full hours after the redemption) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Rewards Member | 2500 | 2500 | 500 | 50000 | 3 | 1 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Silver | 2500 | 2500 | 500 | 75000 | 3 | 1 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Gold | 2000 | 2500 | 100 | 100000 | 2 | 1 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Platinum | 1000 | 2000 | 100 | 150000 | 2 | 24 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Diamond | 1000 | 1000 | 100 | 250000 | 1 | 24 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Obsidian | 500 | 1000 | 100 | 500000 | 1 | 48 |

## Definitions

- Minimum cash redemption: the fewest points in one cash redemption.
- Minimum gift card or charity redemption: the fewest points in one gift card or charity redemption.
- Redemption increment: every redemption is a whole multiple of this many points.
- Most points redeemed to cash per calendar day: the maximum points redeemed to cash on one calendar day.
- Fulfilment time: the latest delivery of a digital gift card after the redemption date, in business days.
- Cancellation window: the full hours after a gift card or charity redemption during which the customer can cancel it before fulfilment.

## Hypothetical readings

- On a Silver membership, with an increment of 500 points, 3500 points is a whole multiple and 3700 points is not; on Gold, with an increment of 100 points, 3700 points is a whole multiple.
- On Obsidian a cash redemption of 500 points meets the minimum, while a gift card redemption needs at least 1000 points.
